title: FileChanged
description:
Payload of `notes.file.changed.v1`: one file of a connected vault was created, updated,
renamed or deleted.

A fact. The enclosing envelope carries the owner as `tenant_id` (`user:<id>`) and the
aggregate `notes_file:<file_id>`; the payload does not repeat the owner. It carries a
[`BlobRef`] for the bytes, never the bytes or any part of the file text, and it refuses every
member it does not declare.

`Deserialize` is hand-written because the rules are cross-field: `previous_path` is present
exactly when the kind is `renamed`, `blob` is present exactly when the kind is not `deleted`,
the blob digest equals `revision` and the blob belongs to `ratatoskr-notes`, and
`connection_sequence` is at least 1. It parses a private mirror struct and then calls
[`FileChanged::validate`].

blob.description:
The stored bytes of this revision, owned by `ratatoskr-notes`; its SHA-256 digest equals
`revision`. Present exactly when `change_kind` is not `deleted`.

connection_id.description: The connection the file belongs to.

connection_sequence.description:
The position of this event among the published events of its connection. Starts at 1 for
each connection and grows by exactly one per published event, so a consumer can detect a
missing event.

file_id.description: The file, stable across updates and renames.

media_type.description: The media type of the file bytes.

path.description:
The path of the file after the change, relative to the vault root, in NFC. For `deleted`,
the path the file had when it left the vault.

previous_path.description: The path before the change. Present exactly when `change_kind` is `renamed`.

revision.description:
The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file bytes. For `deleted`, the revision the file had when
it left the vault.

BlobOwner.title: BlobOwner
BlobOwner.description: Deployment identity of the service that owns and resolves a blob.

BlobRef.description:
Reference to content-addressed bytes owned by one service.

This is a reference, not a storage API. The owner writes and resolves the bytes under its own
content-addressed directory. No host, filesystem path, signed URL, credentials, or expiry can
appear in this contract.

digest.description: Digest that names the bytes and lets a reader verify them.

length_bytes.description: Exact byte length of the stored value.

media_type.description: Media type of the stored bytes.

owner_service.description: Service that owns the bytes and their lifecycle.

ContentDigest.description: A content digest with an explicit algorithm.

DigestAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used to calculate a content digest.

DigestHex.title: DigestHex
DigestHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal bytes of a content digest.

FileChangeKind.description:
What happened to the file.

**Closed on purpose**: a consumer branches on the kind to index, move or forget a file, and an
unknown kind must stop processing instead of being read as one of them.

oneOf.description: The file appeared in the vault.
The bytes of the file changed under the same path.
The file left the vault, or became excluded.

MediaType.title: MediaType
MediaType.description: Internet media type of stored bytes, without parameters.

NotesConnectionId.title: NotesConnectionId
NotesConnectionId.description: Identity of one vault connection of ratatoskr-notes. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; not namespaced.

NotesFileId.title: NotesFileId
NotesFileId.description: Identity of one file of a connected vault, stable across renames. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; not namespaced.

VaultPath.title: VaultPath
VaultPath.description:
A file path relative to the vault root, segments separated by `/`.

Not empty, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, no leading or trailing `/`, no empty, `.` or `..`
segment, no backslash and no C0 or DEL control character, so a path can never name a file
outside the vault.

The path is in Unicode NFC. This contract does not check NFC: the producer normalises
every path before it publishes one, and a consumer may rely on it.
